item.title: Turks often keep gold as a hedge against inflation. It may be hurting Turkey's future
item.description: Billions of dollars worth of gold is held in Turkish households outside the banking system. The government aims to convince citizens to put it into the mainstream financial system to help the economy.

item.title: What to make of warnings that AI may pose an existential threat to humanity
item.description: Over the past week, fears of AI wiping out humanity are surging. But could it happen? And if so, how?

item.title: A record number of Israelis have been leaving their country over the last 3 years
item.description: As many as 50,000 Israelis are leaving the country a year, study shows, tired of war and hardline politicians.

item.title: Trump administration's crackdown on immigrant truckers rolls into appeals court
item.description: A federal appeals court panel in D.C. hears arguments Tuesday on the Trump administration's crackdown on immigrant truckers. Critics say that will do little to make the nation's roads safer.

item.description: Residents in Louisiana near SpaceX's next launch site are concerned about the project's impact on the environment and say they were kept in dark about the deal.

item.title: CBO says Iran war driving up inflation, puts price tag at $38 billion
item.description: Two new, independent reports show detailed looks at the costs of the war in Iran. It's led to shortages in U.S. weapons, supply chain bottlenecks and a price tag in the tens of billions of dollars.
